caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical bank featuring an ornate, domed structure predominantly colored in blue, red, white, and green. The main body is shaped like a small building with a curved blue dome roof topped by a metallic-looking knob. The front facade contains a green circular panel with a standing figure of a person in brown and red garments, holding a tray, positioned on blue semi-circular steps. The left side of the structure is decorated with lattice and quatrefoil cutout designs, while the right side has a silver-gray, oval-shaped grille with the inscription "LILIPUT BANK" in blue lettering. Architectural detailing along the edges appears in red, with accents of white and blue. The artist’s name, "FLORIAN ROKITA," is inscribed in the lower right corner of the drawing. The background of the composition is a plain, light beige color.
title: Toy Bank
